title: A type that allows a loaded error with no data and no error
prompt: The Request type in request.ts is four optional fields, so it can describe states that cannot happen — loading and failed at once, done with no data. Replace it with a discriminated union on a `status` field so those states cannot be written at all, and update render() to match. No optional field is to remain.
check: ! codeonly request.ts | grep -qE '\?:' && codeonly request.ts | grep -qE 'status: *"loading"' && codeonly request.ts | grep -qE 'status: *"failed"' && codeonly request.ts | grep -qE 'status: *"done"' && grep -q 'export function render' request.ts
